quotes.summary_phrase: Rui Hachimura on Giannis Antetokounmpo's game-saving block in overtime

quotes.speaker: Rui Hachimura
quotes.summary_phrase: Rui Hachimura on the team's aggressive fast-break transition strategy
quotes.excerpt: We are trying to be aggressive, especially in fast break when they have no set defense.
quotes.quote: We are trying to be aggressive, especially in fast break when they have no set defense. They don't really get back on defense, so that's what we are trying to attack. That's what we did a good job today. We are sharing the ball, passing to each other, so it was more natural to me.
quotes.social_post: Rui Hachimura says the Clippers are focusing on aggressive transition play: We are trying to be aggressive, especially in fast break when they have no set defense. They do not really get back on defense, so that is what we are trying to attack.

structured.context: Rui Hachimura explains the team's strategy of pushing the pace in transition to exploit the opponent's defense.

quotes.speaker: Rui Hachimura
quotes.summary_phrase: Rui Hachimura on the team's need to maintain consistency
quotes.excerpt: We have to keep doing what we are supposed to do.
quotes.quote: We have to keep doing what we are supposed to do. We were up by 20 or something in the first half, and coming out in the second half, we couldn't hold them. They came back, and from there it was a tough game for us. We had a lot of chances, but we couldn't finish it.
quotes.social_post: Rui Hachimura on the Clippers blowing a 20-point lead: We were up by 20 or something in the first half, and coming out in the second half, we could not hold them. We had a lot of chances, but we could not finish it.

structured.context: Rui Hachimura reflects on the team's inability to maintain a large lead and finish the game against their opponent.
